purpose: Lee et al. REDW 2014 Table 1 has CRAM, BRAM, user FF only. No DSP row. Do not invent a DSP Weibull.

ug116.note: AMD UG116 SEU tables cover CRAM, BRAM, URAM. No DSP48 cross-section.

where_to_look: IEEE TNS / REDW: Kintex-7 or Virtex-7 DSP48 SEU / SET (often SET-dominated, not SRAM-like Weibull).
Xilinx/AMD radiation reports that list DSP48 separately from CRAM.

searched: NASA NEPP FPGA SEE talks/papers 2014-2017: the NEPP independent program tested Microsemi RTG4 math blocks (Berg et al., NEPP ETW 2017) - NOT Xilinx 7-series DSP48.
IEEE TNS/NSREC/RADECS via web search: no public DSP48E1 per-bit heavy-ion or proton sigma table found.
AMD/Xilinx UG116: covers CRAM/BRAM/URAM only (already recorded above).
audit_2026_08_22.unverified_lead: Lee et al. also published an extended IEEE TNS journal version (OSTI PURL 1319638; REDW version DOI 10.1109/REDW.2014.7004595 verified to have NO DSP row in Table 1). The TNS version could not be retrieved this session (OSTI unreachable); whether it adds DSP data remains UNVERIFIED - do not cite either way without reading it.
audit_2026_08_22.conclusion: DSP48E1 sigma remains a genuine public-data gap. The current handling (geometry occupancy only, never flipped under flip_model=weibull, excluded from N_SEU) is correct and stays.

occupancy_in_layout_ecc.source: UG479 DSP48E1 data-path register widths A30+B18+C48+D25+P48. Geometry occupancy only.
occupancy_in_layout_ecc.flip_model_weibull: sigma is None; DSP_STATE is never flipped.
